title: Three Sharp Bounds for Hansen Polytopes of Cographs
summary: A Lean 4/Mathlib formalisation of three sharp lower bounds for Hansen polytopes of finite nonempty cographs: normalized Mahler volume at least one, at least 3^d nonempty faces, and at least 2^d d! full flags in dimension d. In each result equality holds exactly for threshold graphs.

review.reason: Lean formalization of sharp lower bounds for Hansen polytopes of cographs.
